extras: No network requests or data collection; limitations exist for embedded notes and tables generated by other plugins.
intentEvidence: Width Wizard replaces that number: - Custom width: pick any width from 400 to 3000px.
problem: Obsidian's default narrow 700px text column and fixed table widths limit screen utilization and flexibility in note formatting.
